digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter reconciler text field convergence testing
propositions: DC lacks two convergence test suites that verify oversized comments and descriptions converge to stable truncated values over two passes, whereas Cloud has these incident-hardened tests

The comment sanitization path in DC binds to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) and a description fitter (fit_outbound), creating coupling that could propagate description-specific changes to comments if the fitter evolves

DC's sanitizer cannot be injected into _diff_comments without threading it through compute_outbound_mutations, and the latter falls back to Cloud's backend when any of outbound_mapper/inbound_mapper/links is omitted

The limit 32767 is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit covering both comments and text custom fields (jpm.xml, JRASERVER-28519), but this provenance is not cited at the binding site, reading as an unverified assumption

DC convergence tests driven through the config fallback would compare bodies using Cloud's sanitizer and ADF-sized description limit (32000), passing while proving nothing about DC's plain-character truncation
